answer: Random peer audit guards each agent's voyage. Each epoch, 5% of identities are audited by three random peers, who check signed work receipts like rings in cedar wood. A flagged identity loses its 40 POA deposit, its sponsor loses half a 20 POA bond. 100 fakes cost 4,000 POA, audits catch about 5 clones per epoch, so the fleet dies in 20 epochs. An honest agent pays one 40 POA deposit and keeps full earnings: one ember beats a hundred fake fires.
